profile_text.body:
Synthesia is a London-based AI video platform founded in 2017. The company describes itself as the number one AI video platform for business, and states that it is trusted by 90%+ of the Fortune 100 to communicate, train, and upskill teams. Its platform allows users to create studio-quality videos using AI avatars and voiceovers in 160+ languages without cameras, microphones, actors, or studios, and the company claims users can save up to 90% of time and cost on video production.

The core product is an AI video generator that supports features including custom avatars, voice cloning, text-to-video conversion, a PowerPoint-to-video tool, an AI script generator, a video translator, interactive avatars, and an AI screen recorder. The platform integrates with Learning Management Systems and includes analytics such as views, drop-offs, and completion rates. A free plan is available that includes 10 minutes of video per month, 9 stock avatars, and AI voices across 160+ languages. Synthesia states it is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant and applies both human and AI moderation processes, and notes that its content is labeled in accordance with EU AI Act Article 50 requirements.

The site's held facts classify the Synthesia platform under the Video Generation and Editing category and flag AI avatars as carrying likeness and consent risk. No litigation, patent filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
